Task complete. Summary:

- Wrote `out/T2/plan.yaml`: a BrainSurgery plan that, per layer `0..11`, rebuilds `c_attn.weight` (concat 6 column slices, dim=1), `c_attn.bias` (concat 6 slices, dim=0), and `c_proj.weight` (concat 2 row slices, dim=0) into temporary names, deletes the originals, and moves the temps back to the original names — since `concat`'s destination and `move`'s destination both must not already exist. All 4 required checks are asserted at the end (three per-layer-0 shape asserts, plus a `count` assert for 160 total tensors).
- Ran it once with `brainsurgery out/T2/plan.yaml` — succeeded, all asserts passed, output written to `out/T2/model.safetensors` with exactly 160 tensors.
- Verified independently (outside the plan) against a direct PyTorch slice/concat of the original checkpoint: all three pruned tensor families are bit-exact per layer, and all 124 untouched tensors are unchanged.
- Wrote `out/T2/REPORT.md` with the participant self-report.
